name: Closeout Reads & Finishing
summary: Warm up your handle and mid-range touch, then read a live closeout and finish hard at the rim on tired legs.

drills.name: Behind-the-Back Stride Dribbles
drills.summary: Walk the length of the court with a behind-the-back dribble on every step.
steps: Start on the baseline in a low walk.
Dribble behind your back each time your front foot lands.
Keep the ball tight to your hip and your eyes on the far rim.
Walk down, then jog back with the same dribble.
Speed up a little each trip.

drills.name: Short Corner Jumpers
drills.summary: Build mid-range touch from the short corners on both sides of the rim.
steps: Start in the short corner, about 10 feet from the rim, on the right side.
Square your feet to the rim and shoot. Use the glass only if it's a clean bank angle.
Rebound your shot and get back to the spot.
Make 5, then switch to the left short corner.
Keep switching sides until time runs out.

drills.name: Attack the Closeout
drills.summary: Read how your partner closes out and make the right play in one second.
steps: Stand on the wing. Your partner starts under the rim with the ball.
Partner passes to you and closes out three ways: short, high hands, or flying at you.
Short closeout: shoot it. High hands: rip and drive. Flying at you: shot fake, one dribble, pull up.
Make your decision on the catch. No holding the ball.
Do 6 reps, then switch roles. Repeat from the other wing.

drills.name: Sideline Sprint Finishes
drills.summary: Attack the rim from the sideline at full speed, finish, and sprint back to do it again.
steps: Start on the right sideline at the free-throw line extended.
Speed dribble to the rim and finish with your right hand.
Grab the ball and sprint dribble back to touch the sideline.
Go again from the left sideline and finish with your left hand.
Keep alternating sides until time runs out. Count your makes.
